autonomous_sft.accepted: actual search, read, calculation and successful submission; correct numeric answer with exact source support; no rejected actions
autonomous_sft.initialization: selected SFT weights with fresh optimizer and scheduler; complete state for subsequent resumes
autonomous_sft.update_rule: ceil(action_samples / 8), fixed cyclic order with longest sample first; report final partial-batch repeats
autonomous_sft.precision: BF16 base, FP32 LoRA and optimizer; BF16 LoRA only in vLLM inference

primary: whole-task success on combined cross_evidence and multi_turn development tasks

confidence_interval.cluster: issuer; missing-company controls share one cluster

acceptance_rule: Freeze settings before agent_v2_test. Report all three routes; no tuning or model selection from acceptance results.
deployment_rule: These comparisons leave the existing fixed service default in place; dynamic quality and adoption decisions must be reported explicitly.
limits: Fixed flow has only a single-question comparator here; unsupported cross-report and multi-turn tasks are not counted as zero-score algorithmic baselines.
context_revision: dialogue-v7: retain complete first read and full numeric catalogue, compact repeated reads, retain all actual current-revision assistant/tool messages; explicit #0 step syntax; full development validation before acceptance
